name: theme-toggle
title: Theme Toggle
description: Theme Toggle is a button that switches between light and dark themes with a sun and moon animation. The component knows nothing about a theme provider: it takes the current theme in theme and reports a change through onThemeChange. That lets you wire it to next-themes or any store of your own. It is built on Button, the icon size comes from the size prop, and the animation turns off under prefers-reduced-motion.
